games.title: Chubby Finn
games.summary: Chubby Finn is a cute Sokoban-style puzzle: help a chubby little seal push every ball into its target spot across carefully designed grids. Plan each move ahead — balls can be pushed but never pulled.
games.description: Play Chubby Finn free online — an adorable Sokoban puzzle game. Guide Finn the seal, push balls to the target, and solve every brain-teasing level. No download, no sign-up.

sections.h2: How do you play Chubby Finn?
sections.body: Chubby Finn is a grid-based puzzle where you steer a chubby seal around with the arrow buttons. Your goal is to push every ball onto its glowing target position. The catch: a ball can only be pushed, never pulled, so one careless shove can block a level forever. Before you start pushing, walk the path in your head — plan every turn so Finn never traps a ball or himself against the wall.

Levels are designed as bite-sized brain teasers — short enough for a coffee break, tricky enough to make you rethink your first move. The art stays cute and clean, and it runs smoothly on both desktop and touch screens, so you can pick it up on any device without an install or a sign-up.

faq.a: Yes. The game is completely free to play in your browser, supported by non-intrusive ads.
On desktop, use the on-screen arrow buttons or your keyboard's arrow keys. On mobile, tap the arrow buttons shown on the game board.

faq.q: What if I push a ball the wrong way?
faq.a: Balls can't be pulled back, so if you trap one, simply restart the level. Each level is short, so a reset costs only a few seconds.

games.title: Geometry Vibes X Ball
games.summary: Geometry Vibes X Ball is a fast one-button arcade hopper: click and hold to fly up, release to dive, and thread through obstacles, traps and gears across new levels and a challenge mode.
games.description: Play Geometry Vibes X Ball free online. A one-button arcade runner with 1-4 player modes, new levels, a challenge section and a fresh store. No download.

sections.body: It is a true one-button game: hold the left mouse button or press and hold the Up Arrow to fly upward, release to dive down. Everything — timing jumps, clearing gaps, threading between gears — comes down to when you hold and when you let go. In 2-4 player modes, other players use Up, H and L keys.

sections.h2: What is new in the X-Ball mode?
sections.body: Beyond the original campaign, X-Ball adds interactive new levels, a dedicated challenge section and a completely rebuilt store, so runs feel fresh even if you already know the first game. Each level still boils down to dodging obstacles, traps and gears.

faq.q: Is Geometry Vibes X Ball free?

faq.q: Can I play it with friends?
faq.a: Yes — it supports 1 to 4 player modes on the same keyboard. Other players use the Up, H and L keys.
The game keeps your progress locally in the browser, so you can leave and come back later.

Early levels teach you the rhythm of placing and dodging; later mazes stack more blocks, tighter corridors and trickier placement choices. It rewards thinking one step ahead more than fast reflexes.

faq.a: Yes, completely free in your browser.
Use a mouse click or tap on the screen — simple one-button controls.
Progress is kept locally, so you can come back to the maze you left.

sections.body: Click or tap Start Engine to launch. The boost marker sweeps back and forth — press Space or tap boost exactly when it crosses the gold zone for maximum impact. Timing the boost is what turns a bump into a full demolish.
